title: Development and validation of a multiphase CT radiomics-based machine learning model for prognostic prediction in sarcomatoid renal cell carcinoma.
summary: The combined model reached test C-index 0.737; difference from clinical model was not significant (P=0.115). CT radiomics combined with clinical predictors in a multiphase model for sarcomatoid renal-cell carcinoma. Testing: Held-out internal test and bootstrap/cross-validation are reported; small cohort and nonsignificant gain constrain claim..
